Submission checklist
====================

#. Extract the prepared project to a new folder, preserving its .git directory.
#. Run the application or the test suite from that extracted folder.
#. Run the Docker checks in SUBMISSION_STEPS.md. These require Docker Desktop.
#. Publish main, docs and container to your public GitHub repository.
#. Check that GitHub shows the updated README, Dockerfile and generated HTML.
#. Check capstone.txt contains the actual public repository URL.
#. Upload the requested project files and capstone.txt to the course task folder.
#. Select **Request review** only after the checks pass.

Keep .env, databases and virtual environments private. Do not submit old duplicate
archives or snippets. The prepared repository has local Git commits; uploading
files through GitHub's web interface alone will not preserve the branch history.
